findings.subject: NCT05174416
findings.R_source_quote: Phase 3 trial of mavacamten in Chinese patients with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) ongoing, with data expected mid-year 2023
findings.f_method: Compare guided readout timing to the CT.gov primary-completion date and its DRIFT across registration versions.
findings.rationale: The claim filed 2023-03-27 states data expected "mid-year 2023", which aligns with the registered primary completion date of 2023-04 (April 2023) as of version 2 dated 2022-12-27. However, the primary_completion_timeline shows the date slipped from "2022-11" (version 0, 2021-12-13) to "2023-04" (version 2, 2022-12-27)—a 5-month slip. Marketing maintained "mid-2023" guidance consistently from August 2022 (claim liany_008) through this March 2023 claim, presenting the timeline as stable/on-track while the registered date had already slipped significantly from the original November 2022 target.
findings.m_evidence: primary_completion_timeline: version 0 (2021-12-13) = "2022-11"; version 2 (2022-12-27) = "2023-04"

findings.m_evidence: primary_completion_timeline: version 0 (2021-12-13) = "2022-11"; version 2 (2022-12-27) = "2023-04"
